mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, content, payload) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{payload})
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
